absences: CVEA Valdez (Alaska): the only 2026-era claim found was a search summary saying the project was dropped; the fetched akbizmag article is dated 2022-02-04 and says the feasibility study was 'to be completed by July', so no check was written. Current status unverified.
Lunar surface power: no contract, award, or schedule news after the Jan-Feb 2026 DOE and NASA releases was found. Shipped timeline text left as is except the signing-date phrasing checked below.
Penn State eVinci: no 2026 NRC docket or construction permit news found; the psu.edu release (dated 2025-03-04) matches the shipped LOI date of 28 February 2025, so no check written.

TAMU RELLIS date conflict for the human to resolve: tamu-rellis-aalo (segments) says agreements announced 2025-02-05, while tamu-rellis (deployment_sites) says announced 2025-02-04. The WNN article is dated 2025-02-05 and gives no signing date, so neither date is confirmed. No check written.

Steady Energy LDR-50: first concrete on 2026-02-12 comes from search summaries; the NEI page fetched is dated 2026-02-17 and states the pour without a date. Jyvaskyla LOI with Alva-yhtiot (search summary, May 2026) was not confirmed on a fetched page and is not added.

Hospitals: no 2026 signed microreactor agreement for a hospital with a megawatt figure was found. The Radiant Kaleidos hospital backup claim is from a recruiting page and is marketing copy, not an agreement.

Disaster recovery: DHS/FEMA mobile and transportable microreactor solicitation (closing 2026-01-09, estimated $722 million across two awards) was found on a search summary only, with no award and no fetched power figure. Not added.
Military civilian loads: Army Janus awards are already in deployment_sites, and the Radiant Air Force delivery is a military base, which the contract treats as context only. Not added.
Regions (Type E): no new region outside skip/regions.json with both a price and a load number was found within budget.
Items (Type N): not searched; news-agent lane.
Nuclea and New Mining: second source (DataCenterDynamics) returned 403 and GlobeNewswire returned 403; the record rests on one fetched StockTitan copy of the release.
Idaho Strategic and Radiant: the Radiant blog returned 403; the record rests on a fetched webdisclosure copy of the 2024-05-08 release. No mine load figure is published in that release.
Oklo and Wyoming Hyperscale: DataCenterDynamics (DCD) reports a 10-year PPA term while ANS reports 20 years; the record uses the fetched ANS 20-year figure. DCD was not fetched (403 not retried).

NANO Nuclear and Digihost (North Tonawanda, NY): the 60 MW figure is the host gas plant's capacity, not a facility load, so it was not used under the load-is-demand rule. NANO and Supermicro MOU (2026-05-13 article) gives no MW figure and is non-binding.

applications.name: Nuclea Energy and New Mining Co. data-center MOU (Morpheus microreactor)
applications.power_class: 3.5-50 MWe per Morpheus unit (design range); first phase about 30 MWe of load
applications.timeline: MOU announced 2026-08-06; phased engineering study, no construction date
applications.what_it_says: Nuclea Energy and New Mining Co. signed a non-binding MOU on 2026-08-06 to study a behind-the-meter Morpheus microreactor for New Mining's data centers. The first phase covers engineering for New Mining's current operational data-center load of about 30 MWe, with expansion toward up to 100 MWe. The MOU is not a power purchase agreement.
applications.microreactor_read: The 3.5-50 MWe Morpheus design range includes a 1-20 MW block, but this is a design-stage MOU with no commercial unit, and it sets no supply price.

sources.label: StockTitan — Mangoceuticals merger partner Nuclea Energy signs MOU with New Mining Co. (2026-08-06)
sources.quote: The MOU is non-binding and does not constitute a power purchase agreement

applications.name: Oklo and Wyoming Hyperscale, Aspen Mountain data-center campus (letter of intent)
applications.power_class: 100 MW of carbon-free power (letter of intent)
applications.timeline: letter of intent announced May 2024 (ANS article dated 2024-05-29); 20-year power purchase agreement proposed
applications.what_it_says: Oklo and Wyoming Hyperscale signed a nonbinding letter of intent to supply 100 MW of carbon-free power for a 20-year power purchase agreement. The data center is planned for Aspen Mountain, a remote site southeast of Evanston, Wyoming. The source gives no price.
applications.microreactor_read: 100 MW is more than one 1-20 MW block, so it would take several units. The letter of intent is non-binding, and no price is published in the source.

sources.label: American Nuclear Society — Oklo, Wyoming Hyperscale partner for data center energy (2024-05-29)
sources.quote: signed a nonbinding letter of intent to provide 100 megawatts of carbon-free energy for a 20-year power purchase agreement

applications.name: Idaho Strategic Resources and Radiant Kaleidos (Frontier pilot)
applications.power_class: 1 MWe per Kaleidos unit (1.9 MWt heat)
applications.timeline: non-binding MOU announced 2024-05-08; the release names no mine load and no construction date
applications.what_it_says: Idaho Strategic Resources and Radiant Industries signed a non-binding MOU on 2024-05-08. It sets a path for the two companies to operate one or more of the first five Frontier Kaleidos units at a viable Idaho Strategic site. Kaleidos can output 1 MWe electric and 1.9 MWt of heat.
applications.microreactor_read: 1 MWe sits at the bottom of the 1-20 MW block, so one unit would cover only a small share of a working mine's load. The MOU is non-binding and the release gives no mine load or price.
